verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a SaaS CRM, but the evidence pack never mentions telemetry, usage tracking, or any opt-out control. Related items such as 'Forget a Contact' (deleting a customer record), audit logs and field-level permissions are adjacent data-management features. They are not a user telemetry opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
